title: PPO net2 gate on net1 v5: the candidates over three seeds against the fixed rule, on validation links
description: The gate of 2026-11-11 for a learned net2. The three PPO candidates of exp-net2-ppo-search2-96 (all on the competition mix, tau = 1 s, sigma = 0.05: learning rate 1e-4 with K = 4, 1e-3 with K = 2, 1e-3 with K = 4), each trained on seeds 1, 2 and 3 (exp-net2-ppo-seeds; their policies stashed in release model-net2-ppo-candidates), run next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, with campaign seed 21 (the search's evaluations used 11). The rule, fixed before the run (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py): per link, the mean over a candidate's seeds of its log utility minus the rule's; the candidate kept has the highest five-family mean; the gate passes if it beats the rule in cubic-first-60 and in new-20's competition conditions (Cubic from 0 s, BBRv1 from 4 s, two Cubic flows), each with its 95% interval over links above 0, is at or above the rule on the five-family mean, and is not worse with copies beyond its interval. Otherwise net2 stays the fixed rule and the share rule. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
